boundaries: Residue Measurement is one semantic use of Measurement Method; the positive Method Definition also supports other governed properties.
Each execution binds exact subject, conditions, Method version, Tool and Implementation versions, and calibration state.
Changing the procedure or uncertainty treatment requires a new Method version.
claim_ceiling: This candidate defines Measurement Method for Step 3 review only and has no admission or downstream activation effect.
residue_refs: Artifact Type rebinding and admission remain separate.

scope.applicability: A Measurement Method is a versioned reproducible procedure for measuring one declared property of a subject under stated conditions, with units, instruments or Tools, Implementation, calibration, sampling, computation, uncertainty treatment, evidence, applicability, owner, and failure boundaries.
exclusions: It is not a Measurement Result, Observation, metric value, Finding, Evidence Set, Decision, or authority rule.
Method admission does not prove calibration, correct execution, suitability for a subject, or acceptance of a result.
This Definition does not admit a carrier, instance, relation, runtime, consumer, publication, or deployment.

examples: method:residue-entropy/v2 defines how to calculate entropy over a typed residue register, including sampling window, formula, implementation digest, calibration fixture, and uncertainty rule.
